blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings went from 12 to 5, and it took 1.6% of the city’s 124 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings went from 5 to 8, and it took 5.4% of the city’s 37 sales over the period.

faq.a: The City of Mission's Official Community Plan, Bylaw 6405-2026 — adopted April 21, 2026 on the settled position in this program — which also defines the Silverdale Comprehensive Planning Area. The guide page states a June 1, 2026 adoption date in both its Planning section and its FAQ, which conflicts with that position and is recorded as a live-page error in Section 1 of this file.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Mission West Mission than in June?
faq.a: Between June 2026 and September 2026, listings of houses fell from 12 to 5 and condos and townhomes rose from 5 to 8 in Mission West Mission.

faq.q: How big is Mission West Mission compared with the rest of Mission?
faq.a: In September 2026, Mission West Mission held 2.2% of the 231 houses listed in Mission and 6.6% of the 122 condos and townhomes listed in Mission.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Mission West Mission from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 2 houses and 2 condos and townhomes sold in Mission West Mission over those 4 months.
